01.title: The Pomodoro Technique
01.description: Study with intense focus for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break. After four cycles, take a longer break. Keeps your mind sharp and prevents burnout.

02.title: Active Recall
02.description: After reading a section, close your notes and write down everything you can remember from memory. Testing yourself is far more effective than re-reading.

03.title: Past Papers First
03.description: Don't wait until you finish the syllabus. Attempt past papers early to understand exam patterns, find your weak spots, and direct your study time.

04.title: Mind Mapping
04.description: Draw visual maps connecting core concepts. Especially powerful for Engineering Technology, Science units, and subjects with interconnected ideas.

05.title: Teach Someone Else
05.description: Explain a concept out loud to a friend or to yourself. The Feynman technique instantly reveals gaps in your understanding.

06.title: Sleep & Review
06.description: Review your hardest notes right before sleeping. Your brain consolidates memories during sleep — harness this biological superpower.

disclaimerPage.title: Disclaimer
disclaimerPage.lastUpdated: This page was last updated in August 2026.
disclaimerPage.p1: PastPaperZone is an independent, student-run educational resource project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Department of Examinations Sri Lanka or the Ministry of Education.
disclaimerPage.p2: All past exam papers and marking schemes hosted on this website are materials previously released into the public domain for educational access. We organize and provide them free of charge for student convenience — we do not claim ownership of the original exam papers.
disclaimerPage.p3: While we make every effort to ensure papers and marking schemes are accurately labeled and complete, human errors (wrong year, mismatched medium, missing pages) can occasionally occur. Always cross-verify critical exam details with your school or educational institute.
disclaimerPage.p4: All content provided on this platform is for personal, non-commercial student study purposes. Do not re-upload or sell these documents on commercial platforms.
disclaimerPage.p5: If you believe any file infringes copyright or contains an error, please use the "Request Missing Paper" or "Contact Us" form and we will review and remove/correct it promptly.
